note: Options Table ships one field widget plugin, OptionsTableWidget (id 'options_table', label 'Draggable Table'), for field types entity_reference, list_integer, list_float, list_string, multiple_values=TRUE. It extends core OptionsWidgetBase and renders a #type table with a tabledrag Weight column so multi-value selections keep a chosen delta order. Its only setting is toggle_label (heading of the checkbox/radio column). No config entity, no configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no plugin types. Persistent state is the widget choice on a field component in an entity_form_display config entity: content.<field>.type=options_table (+ settings.toggle_label). Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real form-display config on node.article; scripts create namespaced field_ot_* list fields.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module options_table, what is the machine id of the field widget it provides, and which field types can use it?
evals.expected_output: The widget id is options_table (label 'Draggable Table'). It supports the field types entity_reference, list_integer, list_float and list_string, and is a multiple-values widget extending core OptionsWidgetBase.

evals.prompt: How does the options_table 'Draggable Table' widget differ from the core Check boxes/radio buttons widget for an options field?
evals.expected_output: It renders the allowed options as a draggable table with a Weight column, so the editor can drag the selected options into a chosen order and that order is stored as the field delta order. Core checkboxes/radios only toggle selection and cannot set the weight/order of the selected options.

evals.prompt: The options_table widget has no admin settings page. What is its one configurable widget setting, and in which config entity is the widget choice stored for a field?
evals.expected_output: The only widget setting is toggle_label (an optional heading for the checkbox/radio column). You select the widget on the entity's Manage form display; it is stored in the entity_form_display config entity as content.<field>.type: options_table with settings.toggle_label.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an options field whose edit widget was switched to the options_table 'Draggable Table' widget. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_ot_known: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component has type: options_table (with settings.toggle_label 'Choose').

evals.prompt: The Article content type has two list_string fields, field_ot_drag and field_ot_plain. Exactly one uses the options_table Draggable Table widget; the other uses the core Check boxes/radio buttons widget. Inspect the live form-display configuration and state which field uses the draggable table widget.
evals.expected_output: field_ot_drag uses the draggable table: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component type is options_table, whereas field_ot_plain's component type is options_buttons.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a list_integer field field_ot_task that currently uses the core 'Select list' (options_select) widget on the default form display. Switch its edit widget to the options_table 'Draggable Table' widget and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_ot_task component now has type: options_table (e.g. load the entity_form_display, set the component's type to options_table via setComponent(), and save; or choose Draggable Table on Manage form display).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a list_string field field_ot_label that already uses the options_table Draggable Table widget but with no toggle label. Set the widget's toggle label to 'Selected' and apply the change to the live default form display.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_ot_label options_table component has settings.toggle_label: 'Selected' (set the component's settings['toggle_label'] and save, or fill Toggle label on the widget's settings in Manage form display).
